After several weeks of testing, WhatsApp has officially rolled out a brand-new in-chat search button to iPhone users. Details below.

Button appears when scrolling up

Earlier last month, WhatsApp began testing a new search button placed at the bottom-right corner of the chat interface, making it easier for users to launch the search function.

Before this update, users who wanted to search within a chat had to first tap the contact or group name at the top of the conversation, then select the search option from the chat info page, and only then return to the main chat screen to type their query.

By comparison, the in-chat search button streamlines the entire process, allowing users to start searching instantly without leaving the conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp has now officially launched the in-chat search button, but its position differs from that during the testing period.

WABetaInfo reports as follows:

WABetaInfo pointed out that the new shortcut works equally well in personal chats, group chats, and channels. In all three cases, when the user scrolls up within a conversation or channel, the button appears near the top of the screen; when the user scrolls back to the bottom, the button disappears.

As with most WhatsApp feature rollouts, the new search button may take some time to reach all users.
